GLI-INGEST

The GLI ingestion crawler.

If you are a site owner and saw gli-ingest in your logs, this page is for you.

What it is

gli-ingest is the automated fetcher behind GLI, a provenance-first entity graph of people and organizations built from public documents. It retrieves publicly accessible pages so their contents can be attributed to the entities they mention, with the source kept attached to every claim. It identifies itself honestly on every request:

gli-ingest/0.1 (+https://finitebuilds.com; security@finitebuilds.com)

It does not imitate a browser and does not vary its identity to get past a block.

What it collects

Publicly accessible civic records and news pages relevant to the entity graph. It stores what it fetches content-addressed, for provenance and de-duplication. It does not attempt authenticated, paywalled, or private content, and it does not submit forms or log in.

How it behaves

  • Respects robots.txt It checks each origin's robots.txt before fetching and honours it. If robots.txt is withheld (401/403), unreachable, or disallows the path, it does not fetch.
  • Polite by default Rate-limited per source, with backoff on 429/Retry-After. It is a low-volume collector, not a bulk mirror.
  • Identifies, never impersonates The User-Agent above names the project and carries a contact route. If you would rather it not fetch your site, tell us and it will not.

Reach us

Questions, corrections, or a request to be excluded: security@finitebuilds.com. We will honour exclusion requests.
